name: elimination method
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 通过消去部分变量构造约化方程的方法。
usage_overview: 用于子结构耦合分析中的系统方程约化：依据界面位移关系变换系统矩阵，消去冗余边界变量，使约化后的方程体现子结构之间的位移协调关系。

complete_examples.text: In conclusion, the elimination method demonstrates superior performance in terms of both computational accuracy and efficiency.

Based on this, a substructure coordination method based on penalty method, Lagrange multiplier method and elimination method is proposed to reduce the dimension of the dynamic matrices in the far-field ground vibration of railway system.
Additionally, this paper introduces a substructure coordination technique combining the FEM and SEM, based on the elimination method.
